Name: Funky Fumos
Author: StellaUnderscore
Description:
[b]THIS MOD REQUIRES [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9365?tab=description]DYNAMIC GAME ASSETS BY SPACECHASE0[/url], [/b]SO PLEASE DOWNLOAD THAT FIRST!

It also requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].

The internet sensations are now in Stardew Valley!

[b]As of 1.1.0 (current version) there are 5 fumos.[/b]
- Cirno (added in 1.0.0)
- Reimu Hakurei (added in 1.0.0)
- Remilia Scarlet (added in 1.0.0)
- Satori Komeiji (added in 1.1.0)
- Koishi Komeiji (added in 1.1.0)

I have plans to add more, but if i run out of ideas feel free to suggest some! (although i will only add Touhou characters, so keep that in mind.)

Each fumo is 2 tiles wide and 2 tiles tall (so i guess they're technically deka fumos lol) and has a collision box of 2 tiles wide and 1 tile tall.[b] They are not able to be rotated[/b] [i]but[/i] i [i]may[/i] add that in the future if i feel adventurous. [b]All fumos can be bought at Robin's shop.[/b]

Big thank you to Elizabeth on the Stardew Valley discord for helping me iron out some errors and bugs!
